title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
title_es: Amazon lanza TorchNeuron para desafiar el dominio de Nvidia en PyTorch
bajada: Amazon presenta TorchNeuron, una herramienta para ejecutar modelos de IA en sus chips Trainium sin dependencia de Nvidia. Este movimiento busca romper el monopolio de Nvidia en el stack de ML y democratizar opciones de hardware para developers.
bajada_en: Amazon launches TorchNeuron to run AI models on Trainium chips independently from Nvidia. This move aims to break Nvidia's monopoly in the ML stack and provide developers with alternative hardware options.

title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
summary: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown […]
title_es: Investigadores descubren ataque con ejército de agentes IA a 100+ sitios web
bajada: Un hacker utilizó agentes IA autónomos para infiltrarse en más de 100 sitios web, incluyendo John Deere y SharkNinja. El caso demuestra la amenaza emergente de agentes IA operando con autonomía mínima para campañas de ciberseguridad.
bajada_en: A hacker used autonomous AI agents to breach over 100 websites, including John Deere and SharkNinja. The case demonstrates the emerging threat of minimally-supervised AI agents in cybersecurity campaigns.

title: TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever
title_es: Hugging Face integra TorchNeuron para AWS Trainium
bajada: Hugging Face facilita la ejecución de modelos en AWS Trainium mediante TorchNeuron, reduciendo fricción para developers. La integración simplifica el despliegue de modelos en infraestructura alternativa a Nvidia.
bajada_en: Hugging Face streamlines running models on AWS Trainium with TorchNeuron integration. This makes it easier for developers to deploy models on alternative infrastructure.

title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
summary: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.
title_es: Anthropic y Nscale negocian otro contrato de $45 mil millones en compute
bajada: Anthropic y Nscale están en conversaciones para un segundo acuerdo de $45 mil millones en recursos de computación. Este movimiento refleja la carrera por asegurar capacidad de cómputo crítica para entrenar modelos de frontera.
bajada_en: Anthropic and Nscale are in talks for another $45 billion compute deal. This reflects the intense competition to secure computational capacity for training frontier models.

title: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
summary: “I think I have good news about the nature of neural networks.” With those simple words of optimism, Nick Cammarata, a researcher at the AI startup Goodfire, kicked off a 26,000-word blog post that has knocked the AI world on its head, sparking wild speculation as well as cautious (and not-so-cautious) celebration. Cammarata’s claim is…
title_es: Investigador de Goodfire publica hallazgo que sacude la industria de IA
bajada: Nick Cammarata publicó un análisis de 26,000 palabras sobre la naturaleza de redes neuronales que ha generado debate masivo en la comunidad. El contenido combina investigación técnica con especulación sobre cómo entendemos los modelos actuales.
bajada_en: Nick Cammarata published a 26,000-word analysis on neural networks that sparked widespread debate in the AI community. The work combines technical research with speculation about how we understand current models.

title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
title_es: Hackers comprometieron OpenCode y robaron claves API de usuarios
bajada: Hackers accedieron a la plataforma de OpenCode, una herramienta de coding con IA popular, y robaron claves API que usaron para generar cargos fraudulentos. El incidente destaca riesgos de seguridad en herramientas open-source de IA sin suficiente hardening.
bajada_en: Hackers compromised OpenCode's platform and stole API keys to run up fraudulent charges. The incident highlights security risks in open-source AI tools lacking proper security hardening.

title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
title_es: Microsoft alerta: agentes IA son riesgos como amenazas internas
bajada: Microsoft advierte a empresas sobre tratar agentes IA como amenazas internas, sugiriendo que los modelos frontier no pueden ser plenamente confiables. La recomendación busca que las organizaciones implementen supervisión rigurosa de agentes en sistemas críticos.
bajada_en: Microsoft warns enterprises to treat AI agents like insider threats, noting that frontier models can't be fully trusted. The recommendation pushes organizations to implement strict oversight of agents on critical systems.

title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.
title_es: OpenAI mejora ChatGPT para lenguajes de programación poco usados
bajada: OpenAI está ampliando las capacidades de ChatGPT en lenguajes de programación con pocos recursos, incluyendo COBOL y SQLite. Esta mejora es relevante para developers que trabajan con sistemas legacy y tecnologías menos populares.
bajada_en: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT's capabilities for low-resource programming languages, including COBOL and SQLite. This improvement matters for developers working with legacy systems and less mainstream technologies.

title: Interpretability Is the Key to Physical AI, Says World Mechanics CEO Sonia Joseph
summary: Two of the hardest problems in AI right now are creating models that understand the physical world—so calledworld models—and making sense of the internal workings of AI models—otherwise known asmechanistic interpretability.Typically, these are treated as two separate problems: researchers working on world models are often not concerned with their internal workings, and interpretability researchers tend to focus on the language models that power most AI tools we currently use. But Sonia Joseph, the co-founder and CEO of a new startup, World Mechanics, argues that world models and interpretability aretwo sides of the same coin. Joseph joined the latest episode of AI Deep Dive to explain that connection, which could be key to making AI useful in the physical world, from medicine to manufacturing. (The full episode is available here.)
title_es: World Mechanics: interpretabilidad como clave para IA física
bajada: Sonia Joseph argumenta que interpretabilidad y world models son dos caras de la misma moneda para IA aplicada al mundo físico. El enfoque integrado podría ser crucial para aplicaciones en medicina y manufactura.
bajada_en: Sonia Joseph argues that interpretability and world models are two sides of the same coin for physical AI. This integrated approach could be crucial for applications in medicine and manufacturing.

title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
summary: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone. The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to…
title_es: Investigadores dejan agentes IA solos 30 horas: comienzan a 'jugar'
bajada: Investigadores aislaron versiones de Claude en una isla virtual por 30 horas sin instrucciones explícitas y observaron comportamiento similar al juego. El experimento revela cómo agentes IA desarrollan comportamientos exploratorios sin dirección específica.
bajada_en: Researchers isolated Claude instances on a virtual island for 30 hours without explicit tasks and observed play-like behavior. The experiment reveals how AI agents develop exploratory behaviors without specific direction.

title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
summary: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch […]
title_es: Evaluadores IA embebidos no serán solución fácil, advierte Hugging Face
bajada: Irene Solaiman, CPO de Hugging Face, advierte que los benchmarks de IA siguen siendo imperfectos y que embeddings evaluadores no resolverán problemas de evaluación. La observación cuestiona la confiabilidad de métodos actuales de comparación entre modelos.
bajada_en: Hugging Face's chief policy officer warns that AI benchmarks remain imperfect and embedded evaluators won't solve evaluation problems. The observation questions the reliability of current model comparison methods.

title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
summary: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here. Until recently, you could divide internet users into just two categories: bots and people. Websites have long allowed bots to perform automated tasks, like capturing the content of web pages, but rules…
title_es: Optimizar internet para agentes IA podría perjudicar al resto de usuarios
bajada: A medida que crece la importancia de agentes IA, cambios para optimizarlos podrían degradar la experiencia de usuarios humanos. El dilema plantea tensiones entre permitir automatización de agentes y mantener una internet usable para personas.
bajada_en: As AI agents grow in importance, optimizations for them could degrade the experience for human users. The dilemma highlights tensions between enabling agent automation and maintaining an internet usable for people.

title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
summary:
arXiv:2610.22507v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. Evaluations reveal profound capability gaps in frontier agents: the best configuration attains an average score of only 49.2%, and when evaluated by the joint collaboration score ($J_{\mathrm{collab}}$), the peak performance reaches merely 37.6%. These results show that task effectiveness diverges sharply from collaboration quality, with models consistently struggling in steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundary management. REALCLI provides a rigorous, reproducible foundation for measuring and advancing collaborative CLI agents.
title_es: RealCLI: benchmark unificado para agentes CLI con colaboración humana
bajada: Un nuevo benchmark evalúa agentes CLI midiendo tanto ejecución de tareas como calidad de colaboración humano-máquina. Los resultados muestran que incluso los mejores agentes alcanzan solo 37.6% en evaluación conjunta de colaboración.
bajada_en: A new benchmark evaluates CLI agents on both task execution and human-machine collaboration quality. Results show that even the best agents reach only 37.6% on joint collaboration scoring.

title: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help
summary: In the cavernous hall of Kraftwerk, a former power station in Berlin, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sat down to discuss Germany’s AI roadmap, and in particular, the industrial applications of AI. Huang opened by tracing NVIDIA’s longstanding relationship with German industry, beginning with gaming systems, workstations and automotive […]
title_es: Alemania busca liderar en IA industrial con apoyo de Nvidia
bajada: Alemania está desarrollando su roadmap de IA industrial con colaboración de Nvidia. El enfoque aprovecha relaciones de larga data en tecnología entre ambas partes.
bajada_en: Germany is developing its industrial AI roadmap with Nvidia collaboration. The effort leverages long-standing technology partnerships between both parties.

title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production
summary: At a creative industry event that took place today in Berlin — hosted in collaboration with Adobe, Bertelsmann, NVIDIA and UFA — the latest advancements in intelligent media were on display. Key to the news: the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) is collaborating with NVIDIA to expand its sovereign framework with cloud, open models and integration […]
title_es: Nvidia y EBU colaboran en seguridad de agentes para medios
bajada: La European Broadcasting Union se asocia con Nvidia para expandir su framework soberano de IA aplicada a medios. La colaboración integra modelos open-source y seguridad de agentes en producción de contenido.
bajada_en: The European Broadcasting Union partners with Nvidia to expand its sovereign AI framework for media. The collaboration integrates open-source models and agentic security in content production.
